expectations.assertion: Records A4 as not_provided (or an equivalent explicit non-delivery verdict), not as pass
expectations.reason: Transcript requests information and defers verdict; it never records A4 or issues any verdict at all.

expectations.assertion: Concludes the run fails because a Must-have was not provided
expectations.reason: Transcript states a conditional ('If A4 is a Must-have...') but does not conclude that THIS run fails.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT drop A4 from the report or fold it into another ID
expectations.reason: Transcript treats A4 as a distinct item and does not drop or merge it.

expectations.assertion: States that a promised follow-up is not delivery at this head
expectations.reason: Transcript asks whether the follow-up deferral is authorized but does not state the verdict about delivery at this head.

expectations.assertion: Notes that A4 could only be removed from the contract by an explicit superseding authority, and none is cited
expectations.reason: Transcript asks about authorization status but does not note the principle or state that no authority was cited.
